ledger: Dancer (woman) | back to camera, black sports bra and leggings, hair in bun, dark tattoo on right upper arm, barefoot | same outfit and stance at end, completing arm raise | performs alternating port de bras: arm raised overhead (0:02), bent-arm pose with open palm (0:04), arms sweep down with head bowed (0:06), arm raised again (0:08); tattoo migrates to the left arm during 0:02-0:04
Mirror reflection | duplicates dancer's pose on the same image side at every frame | still synchronized at end | no desync, no missing or extra limbs detected
Studio environment (door with window, green exit sign, ballet barre, blue bin, wall poster, ceiling lights, paper dispenser) | static, evenly lit | unchanged | no objects appear, disappear, or shift

findings.description: At 0:00 the dark tattoo is clearly on her right upper arm (image-right side of her back) and the left arm is clean. From 0:02 through 0:04, while the right arm performs the raised/bent gesture, the tattoo is instead visible on the hanging left arm (image-left of her spine), with the gesturing right arm clean. By 0:06 the tattoo is back on the right arm and stays there through 0:08. The tattoo switches arms twice; her torso stays essentially frontal (back to camera) throughout, so no body rotation or occlusion explains the change.
